mathematical_approaches.name: Derivative and framing obstruction
mathematical_approaches.attack: Matrix interpolation forced by a smooth cylinder map; compute it for a separating sphere twist.
mathematical_approaches.result: Propositions 2.1–2.2: the unstabilized derivative map is null-homotopic.
mathematical_approaches.unresolved_step: Integrate formal tangent data into a diffeomorphism of the cylinder.

mathematical_approaches.name: Smooth filling nonextension
mathematical_approaches.attack: Transfer a pseudo-isotopy to a collar of an arbitrary filling; test split fillings explicitly.
mathematical_approaches.result: Propositions 3.1–3.2: the twist extends over every compatible boundary connected sum filling.
mathematical_approaches.unresolved_step: Find a non-split filling with a rigorous nonextension obstruction.

mathematical_approaches.name: Finite covering obstruction
mathematical_approaches.attack: Use the kernel of G1*G2 -> G1×G2 and calculate the product of lifted twists.
mathematical_approaches.result: Propositions 4.1–4.2: the cover is #((g1-1)(g2-1))(S2×S1); the natural lifted twist is isotopic to identity.
mathematical_approaches.unresolved_step: Retain a deck-equivariant smooth pseudo-isotopy obstruction.

mathematical_approaches.name: Marked mapping torus comparison
mathematical_approaches.attack: Turn the cylinder map into a marked, cooriented-fiber comparison and compute the classical invariants.
mathematical_approaches.result: Propositions 5.1–5.2: exact marked equivalence; homology, Euler characteristic and signature give no distinction.
mathematical_approaches.unresolved_step: Construct or obstruct a smooth comparison preserving the parametrized cooriented fiber.

mathematical_approaches.name: Relative Casson–Sullivan obstruction
mathematical_approaches.attack: Compute the coset of smoothing obstructions under boundary-fixed changes, using local realization in punctured factors.
mathematical_approaches.result: Lemmas 6.1–6.2 and Theorem 6.3: the full obstruction group is realizable, so a zero-class representative and a stabilized boundary extension exist.
mathematical_approaches.unresolved_step: Remove the interior S2×S2 stabilizations without altering the prescribed ends.
